'''Ghodsi Mohammadi Ziarani''' (born 1964) is an Iranian chemist and Professor of Organic Chemistry at [[Alzahra University]]. Mohammadi Ziarani is among the most-cited Iranian researchers and is known for her works on [[organic chemistry]], [[nanochemistry]], [[multi-component reactions]], [[natural product synthesis]], and [[asymmetric synthesis]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Professor of Alzahra University among the list of top one percent scientists in the world |url=https://www.irna.ir/news/83841443/ |access-date=25 July 2023 |agency=IRNA}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=52 exemplary university professors introduced |url=http://scu.mypr.ir/News/show.aspx?ID=1402 |work=SCU}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Professor of Alzahra University among the list of top one percent scientists in the world |url=https://www.jamaran.news/%D8%A8%D8%AE%D8%B4-%D8%AC%DB%8C-%D9%BE%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%B3-70/1453344-%D8%A7%D8%B3%D8%AA%D8%A7%D8%AF-%D8%AF%D8%A7%D9%86%D8%B4%DA%AF%D8%A7%D9%87-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B2%D9%87%D8%B1%D8%A7-%D8%AF%D8%B1-%D8%AC%D9%85%D8%B9-%D8%AF%D8%A7%D9%86%D8%B4%D9%85%D9%86%D8%AF%D8%A7%D9%86-%DB%8C%DA%A9-%D8%AF%D8%B1%D8%B5%D8%AF-%D9%BE%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%B3%D8%AA%D9%86%D8%A7%D8%AF-%D8%AF%D9%86%DB%8C%D8%A7 |agency=Jamaran News |date=1 July 2020 |language=fa}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Ghodsi Mohammadi Ziarani among the list of top one percent scientists in the world  |url=https://sinapress.ir/news/103859/ |work=Sina Press |date=2 July 2020 |language=fa-IR}}</ref><ref>{{cite book |last1=Ziarani |first1=Ghodsi Mohammadi |last2=Moradi |first2=Razieh |last3=Lashgari |first3=Negar |last4=Kruger |first4=Hendrik G. |title=Metal-Free Synthetic Organic Dyes |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=N_gntAEACAAJ |publisher=Elsevier Science |language=en |date=26 July 2018|isbn=9780128156476 }}</ref>
